## executable-size

Declared by [docs/foundations/memory.md](../../docs/foundations/memory.md).

Executable size: headline as-shipped whole-file bytes from the timed build, including its embedded/linked runtime. Shared-library closure (including libc) is listed separately, never added to one column. The stripped view measures a private copy made with the build clang installation's llvm-strip, verified by executing it against the same output oracle. Both views face the bar independently; byte measurements have spread 1, and stripped own-best requires identical strip version and SHA256. Node/Bun JIT produce no standalone product and remain absent with reasons.
